description: Look up one Louisiana LEGISLATIVE BILL by number and session, "HB142 of the 2026 regular session": the current status, the Act number once it is signed, the author, the short title, the document links for every version (original, engrossed, reengrossed, enrolled, the signed Act, amendments, digests, votes) and the dated action history. This is the bill, not the codified law: for the text of a statute section use louisiana_statute. The bill documents are PDFs, so each version comes back as a link. Keyless; sourced live from the Louisiana State Legislature.

bill.description: Bill number as written: "HB142", "SB 25", "HCR 3", "HR 10", "SCR 7". Prefixes: HB, SB, HCR, SCR, HR, SR, HJR, SJR.

session.description: Session kind: "RS" regular (default), "ES" extraordinary, "1ES" or "2ES" for a numbered extraordinary session.

year.description: Session year, four digits, default the current year. 2026 is the 2026 regular session.

name: louisiana_bill
title: Louisiana Bill
